decision.reasoning: The market has no clear direction. The 24h moves are under 1%, which barely covers the ~0.8% round-trip fee. With $20 of capital, trading has negative expected value after fees. Cash doesn't lose value, so I'm holding to keep my runway and will wait for a clearer setup.

I hold nothing yet, and all three pairs are more than 3% above their 50-day SMA, so all three meet the playbook's slow-trend buy rule. SOL is furthest above its SMA (+19.2%, versus +11.6% for ETH and +8.8% for BTC), so I'm buying it with about 30% of equity ($5.99) and keeping about 70% in cash. The small hourly dip doesn't matter under this rule. I'll sell only if SOL closes more than 3% below its 50-day SMA.
